ui_bugs.component: CutTool (boxed fix tool) - tap printed box then choose letter
ui_bugs.issue: After tapping a printed box and assigning A, the next letter (B) is NOT pre-armed; title goes back to 'Box kheencho, phir batao kiska hai...'. choose() with pending calls place() but never setTarget(next) (only drawn() does). ui_verify212 boxfix expects 'B ka box' -> FAIL desk+mob. Note the very next assertion in the same test expects a drawn rectangle to ask 'kiska hai', so the test itself is contradictory - main agent must decide intended UX and align code (CutTool.js line 224) or test.

Flaky (1 of 3 runs, plain-desk): '-good' ('Saare check paas') is visible from the PREVIOUS check while a new check is in flight (checking=true), so Save is disabled while UI says it can save. Hide -good while checking (line 279) or test should wait for save enabled.
